profile.headline: Software Engineer / Data Engineer / Problem solver
profile.summary: Self-driven Team Lead, Full-stack developer, Data Engineer: .NET, C#, Python, MSSQL, Postgres, API, Backend and Frontend development, Data Science, Machine Learning, AWS

positions.title: Director of Development
positions.description: Took full ownership of managing and optimizing ETL pipelines, utilizing machine learning and Spark for large-scale data processing to ensure seamless bi-weekly data releases. Maintained APIs for plan, drug, drug cost, and quoting while generating and publishing key analytic reports to deliver meaningful insights. Managed database releases to ensure smooth transitions and business alignment. Additionally, I oversee daily data transactions, ensuring data integrity, security, and seamless operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: In the early days of MyMedicareBot, I built core databases from the ground up, including ETL pipelines. I developed the drug cost quote and annual cost calculator, along with its API. I also built analytical reports and created product demos and prototypes to showcase key features.
positions.insights: U.S. Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), Airflow and +21 skills

positions.title: Freelance Consultant
positions.description: Developed mobile game demos for startups, delivering innovative solutions in early-stage development. Led offshore mobile development teams, ensuring smooth communication and successful delivery of business requirements to offshore mobile development teams. Advised banks, including Pacific City Bank and CBB Bank, on web accessibility compliance, ensuring platforms met regulatory standards. Partnered with clients to identify needs and translate requirements into actionable deliverables.

positions.title: Manager of Software Engineering
positions.description: Managed two teams (8 developers and 2 QA) in Peru to build the insurance shopping sites for Medicare and healthcare marketplace. Managed one team (2 developer and 1 QA) in India to support the mobile Medicare enrollment apps (IOS and Android).  Mentored and developed team leaders while facilitating knowledge transfer across global teams.

positions.title: Principal Application Developer for Internal Operations
positions.description: Gathered and analyzed user experiences and requirements from multiple stakeholders to enhance the SaaS platform. Led stakeholder engagement, serving as the primary point of contact to collect feedback and shape the enhancement roadmap. Designed solutions, developed technical guidelines, and created demos to showcase functionalities. Implement and migrate existing data services to SaaS platform.

positions.title: Lead Application Developer for Government projects
positions.description:
Joined as an early team member, oversee all government projects for CMS while leading a group of engineers and QA.
- Developed and maintained a drug quoting and pricing web service (aka. Donut Hole Calculator).
- Built and maintained the Medicare RX plan comparison UI for Medicare.gov and 1-800-MEDICARE.
- Managed a secure Medicare enrollment portal, enabling third-party application submissions while ensuring data integrity.
- Designed and maintained a secure management portal for insurance carriers to download enrollment data in CSV and PDF formats.
- Led annual compliance efforts, ensuring adherence to FIPS, HIPAA, 508 Accessibility, contingency planning, and security audits across multiple government agencies and contractors.
